acceptance_criteria: Non-string destroy elements rejected. cargo test passes.
close_reason: Added pre-flight guard for non-string destroy elements in both principal.rs and notification.rs; 2 new tests; 12 unit tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** In both handle_principal_set (principal.rs) and handle_share_notification_set (notification.rs), the destroy array iteration silently skips non-string elements. Replace with an upfront validation that returns JmapError::invalid_arguments if any element is not a string. Reference pattern: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/identity.rs lines 344-348.

**Algorithm:**
1. In both handlers, after extracting the destroy Value array, add:
   if destroy_arr.iter().any(|v| !v.is_string()) {
       return Err(JmapError::invalid_arguments("destroy array must contain only Id strings"));
   }
2. Apply to both principal.rs and notification.rs.
3. Add tests:
   - Principal/set with destroy:[123] → top-level invalidArguments error.
   - ShareNotification/set with destroy:[null] → top-level invalidArguments error.
4. Verify existing tests still pass.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Both handlers reject non-string destroy elements.
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-server exits 0.
title: Fix: reject non-string destroy array elements with invalidArguments
